# ScienceInsights

> ScienceInsights provides accessible, evidence-based articles exploring wildlife behavior, ecology, health science, and natural phenomena across diverse species and topics.

ScienceInsights covers practical science education spanning animal behavior, seasonal ecology, health facts, and species-specific guides. The site combines research-backed information with actionable guidance for wildlife observation and human health.

## Key Topics

- salmon-migration

## Fish & Aquatic Life

- [When Do the Salmon Run? Timing by Species and Region](https://scienceinsights.org/when-do-the-salmon-run-timing-by-species-and-region): Guide to salmon run timing across species including Chinook, Sockeye, and Coho salmon by region.

## Wildlife & Animal Behavior

- [What Is Elk Rutting Season and When Does It Happen?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-elk-rutting-season-and-when-does-it-happen): Exploration of elk rutting season timing, behaviors, and respectful wildlife observation in Rocky Mountains.
- [How Long Does an Elephant Live in the Wild?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-long-does-an-elephant-live-in-the-wild): Article on African and Asian elephant lifespan, comparing wild versus captive longevity factors.
- [What Eats a Hummingbird? Predators and Survival](https://scienceinsights.org/what-eats-a-hummingbird-predators-and-survival): Article on hummingbird predators including hawks, kestrels, and survival strategies in food webs.
- [When Do Wasps Leave Their Nest for the Year?](https://scienceinsights.org/when-do-wasps-leave-their-nest-for-the-year): Article explaining wasp colony lifecycle, nest abandonment, and annual seasonal behavior patterns.

## Wildlife Care & Rescue

- [How to Save a Butterfly: Rescue, Care, and Release](https://scienceinsights.org/how-to-save-a-butterfly-rescue-care-and-release): Practical guide for butterfly rescue, care, and safe release to support wildlife rehabilitation.
- [What Should I Feed Deer? The Risks of Supplemental Feeding](https://scienceinsights.org/what-should-i-feed-deer-the-risks-of-supplemental-feeding): Guide on deer nutrition, supplemental feeding risks, and responsible wildlife welfare practices.
- [Do Snakes Hate Mothballs? The Truth About Snake Repellents](https://scienceinsights.org/do-snakes-hate-mothballs-the-truth-about-snake-repellents): Debunks mothball myths for snake control, explaining sensory systems and humane prevention methods.

## Health & Medical Science

- [Is It Safe to Be Around Someone After a PET Scan?](https://scienceinsights.org/is-it-safe-to-be-around-someone-after-a-pet-scan): Health article on PET scan radiation exposure safety and post-scan interaction guidelines.
- [Why Is B Negative Blood So Rare?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-is-b-negative-blood-so-rare): Article on B Negative blood rarity, genetics, Rh factor, and importance for blood donation.

## Nutrition & Food Science

- [How Much Protein Is in Rice?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-much-protein-is-in-rice): Nutrition guide comparing protein content across rice varieties and dietary integration methods.

## Core

- [ScienceInsights - Exploring the Frontiers of Knowledge](https://scienceinsights.org): ScienceInsights homepage offering accessible science articles on physics, biology, astronomy, and technology.
